title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our growing team. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining web applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. 

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop scalable web applications
• Write clean, maintainable code
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams
• Mentor junior developers

Requirements:
• 5+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript
• Strong knowledge of React and Node.js
• Experience with PostgreSQL or similar databases
• Excellent problem-solving skills

Benefits:
• Competitive salary and equity
• Health insurance
• Flexible work hours
• Remote-first culture

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Join our team as a Frontend Developer! You'll work on building beautiful and responsive user interfaces using modern frameworks.

What you'll do:
• Build responsive web applications with React
• Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs
• Optimize application performance
• Write unit and integration tests

What we're looking for:
• 3+ years of frontend development experience
• Proficiency in React and TypeScript
• Strong CSS skills and eye for design
• Experience with modern build tools

What we offer:
• Competitive salary ($80k-$100k)
• Hybrid work model (3 days in office)
• Professional development budget
• Great team culture

title: Backend Engineer
description:
We need a talented Backend Engineer to help us scale our infrastructure. You'll work with microservices, databases, and APIs to build robust systems that power our platform.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design and implement RESTful APIs
• Build and maintain microservices architecture
• Optimize database queries and performance
• Ensure system reliability and scalability

Required Skills:
• 5+ years backend development experience
• Strong knowledge of Node.js or Python
• Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
• Proficiency in Docker and Kubernetes
• AWS cloud experience

Perks:
• $110k-$150k salary range
• Stock options
• Relocation assistance
• Top-tier health benefits

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Creative UI/UX Designer wanted! Design beautiful interfaces and user experiences for our SaaS platform.

Your Role:
• Create user-centered designs for web and mobile
• Conduct user research and usability testing
• Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups
• Collaborate with developers to ensure design implementation

Requirements:
• 3+ years of UI/UX design experience
• Strong portfolio demonstrating design process
• Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
• Understanding of design systems and accessibility

Benefits:
• Fully remote position
• $75k-$95k salary
• Flexible schedule
• Design conference budget

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Looking for a DevOps Engineer to manage our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

Responsibilities:
• Manage AWS infrastructure and services
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines
• Implement monitoring and alerting systems
• Automate deployment processes
• Ensure system security and compliance

Requirements:
• 4+ years DevOps experience
• Strong AWS knowledge
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
• Proficiency in Terraform or similar IaC tools
• Scripting skills (Bash, Python)

What we offer:
• $100k-$130k compensation
• Remote work from anywhere
• Latest tech equipment
• Learning and certification budget

title: Junior Web Developer
description:
Great opportunity for a Junior Web Developer to learn and grow! You'll work alongside experienced developers building modern web applications.

What you'll learn:
• Modern web development with React
• Backend development with Node.js
• Database design and optimization
• Agile development practices

We're looking for:
• 0-2 years of professional experience
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Familiarity with React or similar frameworks
• Passion for learning and growth
• Good communication skills

We provide:
• Mentorship program
• $55k-$75k starting salary
• Hybrid work (2 days remote)
• Career growth opportunities

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist needed to analyze large datasets and build machine learning models.

Your Responsibilities:
• Analyze complex datasets to extract insights
• Build and deploy machine learning models
• Create data visualizations and reports
• Collaborate with product teams on data-driven features

Required Qualifications:
• Master's or PhD in related field (or equivalent experience)
• 4+ years of data science experience
• Strong Python programming skills
• Experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch
• Solid understanding of statistics and ML algorithms

Compensation & Benefits:
• $110k-$140k base salary
• Annual bonus
• Remote-first company
• Conference and education budget
• Health, dental, vision insurance

title: Mobile Developer (React Native)
description:
Build amazing mobile apps with React Native! We're looking for a developer passionate about mobile experiences.

What you'll do:
• Develop cross-platform mobile apps with React Native
• Integrate with REST APIs and third-party services
• Optimize app performance and user experience
• Publish apps to App Store and Google Play

Requirements:
• 3+ years mobile development experience
• Strong React Native skills
• Experience with iOS and Android platforms
• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices
• Familiarity with Firebase or similar services

Perks:
• $85k-$105k salary
• Stock options
• Gym membership
• Catered lunches
• Great office in LA

title: Product Manager
description:
Experienced Product Manager to lead our product strategy and roadmap.

Key Responsibilities:
• Define product vision and strategy
• Prioritize features and manage roadmap
• Work closely with engineering and design
• Conduct user research and gather feedback
• Analyze metrics and make data-driven decisions

Qualifications:
• 5+ years product management experience
• Strong technical background
• Excellent communication skills
• Experience with Agile methodologies
• Data-driven decision making

Benefits:
• $120k-$150k base salary
• Equity package
• Hybrid work model
• Unlimited PTO
• Professional development budget

title: QA Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure our software meets the highest standards.

Responsibilities:
• Design and execute test plans
• Develop automated test scripts
• Perform manual and automated testing
• Report and track bugs
• Collaborate with developers on quality improvements

Requirements:
• 3+ years QA experience
• Strong knowledge of testing methodologies
• Experience with Selenium, Jest, or Cypress
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
• Good communication skills

What we offer:
• $70k-$90k salary
• Fully remote position
• Flexible hours
• Modern testing tools
• Supportive team environment
